request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and narrative, Celtic harp, tin whistle, bodhran, low strings, solemn and reverent mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When Arpachshad had lived thirty-five years
He became the father of Shelah
A son in the quiet of the earth
Carrying the weight of Shem

[Pre-Chorus]
When Shelah had lived thirty years
He became the father of Eber
A link in the chain of days
From Noah down to the Hebrews

[Chorus]
Shelah, you stand between the stars
In the genealogy of faith
Connecting the flood to the promise
In the long and living age

[Verse]
After he became the father of Eber
Shelah lived four hundred and three years
And had other sons and daughters
In the shadow of the patriarchs

[Chorus]
Shelah, you stand between the stars
In the genealogy of faith
Connecting the flood to the promise
In the long and living age

[Bridge]
Arpachshad fathered Shelah
And Shelah fathered Eber
Named in the books of Chronicles
And traced in Luke's holy list

[Outro]
From Adam to the King of Kings
The line holds fast through time
